description_en: Queries the restorable time of an ApsaraDB for MongoDB replica set instance with cloud disks
description_zh: 查询云数据库 MongoDB 版云盘版副本集实例的可恢复时间
name: DescribeInstanceRecoverTime

parameters.help_en:
The region where the geo-redundancy backup set is located.

Required when you query geo-redundancy
parameters.help_zh:
异地备份备份集所在地域。

当查询的是异地备份时，需要且必填
parameters.name: dest_region

parameters.help_en:
The area where the source instance of the geo-redundancy backup is located.

Required when you query geo-redundancy
parameters.help_zh:
异地备份源实例所在区域。

当查询的是异地备份时，需要且必填
parameters.name: src_region

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to query only the restorable time ranges that support database and table restoration. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 指定是否仅查询支持库表恢复（数据库/表级恢复）的可恢复时间段。默认值：false
parameters.name: only_db_table_recovery

RestoreRanges.description_en: The list of restorable time ranges. This list includes all time ranges available for point-in-time recovery
RestoreRanges.description_zh: 可恢复时间段列表。包含所有可用于按时间点恢复的时间段

items.description_en: The list of restorable time ranges. This list includes all time ranges available for point-in-time recovery
items.description_zh: 可恢复时间段列表。包含所有可用于按时间点恢复的时间段

RestoreBeginTime.description_en: The start time of the restorable time range. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC time)
RestoreBeginTime.description_zh: 可恢复开始时间。格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

RestoreEndTime.description_en: The end time of the restorable time range. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC time)
RestoreEndTime.description_zh: 可恢复结束时间。格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

RestoreType.description_en:
The restoration method. Valid values:
PointInTime: point-in-time recovery. This is the default value
RestoreType.description_zh:
恢复方式，取值说明：
PointInTime（默认）：基于时间点恢复
